author: Arnav
problem: Read N rooms in a row, the time A_i to move from room i to room i+1, and M bonus rooms (X, Y) that add Y to the remaining time when entered. Starting in room 1 with time T, a move is only allowed if the remaining time stays above 0 afterwards. Print Yes if room N can be reached, otherwise No.
bug_description: Checks T < 0 instead of T <= 0, so arriving with exactly 0 time left is wrongly allowed.

comments.accurate: Walks room by room, spending each corridor's time and adding bonuses, and stops if time runs out
comments.wrong_behavior: Walks room by room; arriving with exactly zero time left is fine as long as the clock never went negative
comments.wrong_location: Time check verified; check the bonus is added for the room being entered, not the one left
